name: mindhive
description: MindHive. /mindhive-orchestrator is the single centralized pipeline: a ten-stage sequential, dynamic workflow (brainstorm → plan → observation → understand → PRD → matrix → kanban → execution → quality → learning) whose main execution engine is restricted to the superpowers and compound-engineering plugins, with every other skill a complement only. It recalls before it asks, advances automatically when intent is clear and converges with the user when it is not, and fans execution out to parallel sub-agents over a file-complexity cluster database (hive clusters). /circle drives the headless Claude Code CLI until a task is done (budget-gated, circuit-broken) — the loop primitive, not the pipeline. /engineering-loop is a subordinate plan→work→review→fix→verify→learn engine the orchestrator may drive; any installed skill is callable through MindHive (green/red status) with failures feeding an improvement loop.
